title: PayPal Blocks GrapheneOS Due to Root Detection Security Policy
summary: Users report that the PayPal app crashes on GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused Android fork, due to a 'RootDetectionSecurityException'. The issue appears related to PayPal's security policies detecting GrapheneOS as a 'rooted' device, despite no actual root access. A temporary workaround involves disabling 'secure app spawning' in GrapheneOS settings. Some users suggest contacting PayPal support or switching to alternative payment apps like Wero.
key_points: PayPal app crashes on GrapheneOS with a `RootDetectionSecurityException`.
GrapheneOS is not rooted but is flagged due to its security-hardened features.
Disabling 'secure app spawning' in GrapheneOS temporarily resolves the issue.
Users recommend contacting PayPal support to advocate for compatibility.
Alternative payment apps like Wero are suggested as workarounds.
